items.html:
A slow left-armer, Kevin Sandher made his debut for Canada as a 19-year-old and in 2001 was in the Under-19 World Cup side. Since then he has a been a virtual ever-present in the side. He took 6 for 68 on his first-class debut in the 2004 Intercontinental Cup and then grabbed 13 wickets at 14.07 in the 2005 ICC Trophy.
Martin Williamson February 2007
